english.title: Fail to report loss of relevant explosive to consignor/consignee
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having

(A)_[transported a relevant explosive,]_
(B)_[loaded a relevant explosive,]_
(C)_[unloaded a relevant explosive]_
(D)_[been the occupier of a place where a relevant explosive was loaded,]_
(E)_[been the occupier of a place where a relevant explosive was unloaded,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY EXPLOSIVE..), failed to report the loss of such an explosive without delay to the

(F)_[consignor]_
(G)_[consignee, the consignor being outside the United Kingdom]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 37(3) of the Explosives Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) of Health and Safety at Work Act 1974.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having transported, loaded or unloaded a relevant explosive or
been the occupier of a place where a relevant explosive was loaded or unloaded,
failed to report the loss of such an explosive without delay to the consignor or
consignee, if the consignor is outside the United Kingdom

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
